description: Controls deliberately excluded from live proof, each with a one-line justification and an owner. Empty today: nothing on this surface qualifies as deliberately inert. Every control in agent-workspace-controls.json is either proven live or unproven with a named reason in the generated coverage ledger. Blocked is not the same as inert and must not be filed here to make the ratio look better: a control only belongs in this file when someone has decided, on purpose, that it will never be exercised.
